$comment: Optional per-repository overrides, keyed by repository name (renames are followed automatically). Every field is optional. The sync never writes to this file.

$fields.featured: true → shown first, in the large card layout
$fields.hidden: true → never shown on the site (the repo stays public on GitHub)
$fields.curated: true → the repo already has a hand-written card on projects.html, so it is not duplicated in the auto-synced grid; if a matching public repository cannot be verified, the card shows no source link instead of guessing a URL
$fields.category: label shown above the title (defaults to primary language)
$fields.summary: your own one-paragraph summary (defaults to the GitHub description / README)
$fields.image: path or https URL of a cover image (defaults to the first README image, then GitHub's social preview)
$fields.demo: live demo URL (defaults to the repo homepage, GitHub Pages, or a demo link found in the README)
$fields.order: number; lower sorts earlier among featured projects

Task_Manager.summary: A task-management web app with list and board views for adding, editing, and organizing tasks.

PersonaLearn.summary: A Streamlit study assistant that explains topics using analogies based on a learner's selected interests, then generates a quiz.

Movie_Recommender_System.summary: A content-based movie recommender using TF-IDF features and cosine similarity, with a Streamlit interface and the TMDB 5000 dataset.

Mybuddy.summary: A personal assistant project exploring conversational AI and custom system prompts.

autonomous-driving-system.summary: A modular autonomous-driving simulation project combining perception, decision logic, path planning, vehicle control, and a Streamlit dashboard. It is a simulation project, not a road-ready autonomous vehicle.

AirTwin-X.summary: An air-quality decision-support prototype combining source attribution, intervention ranking, and scenario simulation. It includes documented fallbacks when live data sources are not configured.

kinesis_prototype.summary: A Streamlit prototype for exploring crowd-behavior scenarios through simulation and data-driven scoring. See the repository README for the exact inputs and limitations.

Fake-News-Detection-.summary: A scikit-learn notebook that uses TF-IDF text features and Logistic Regression for fake-news classification.

MLmini_Projects.summary: A collection of introductory machine-learning notebooks, including a California housing-price prediction exercise. See the README for the current project list.

cursor_bite.summary: A Windows desktop assistant that opens an action menu near the cursor and offers text-processing tools. The repository README distinguishes implemented actions from planned ones.

Spotify_Songs_Genre_Segmentation.summary: A data-science notebook that explores audio features of Spotify tracks and groups songs using machine-learning techniques.

voteros.summary: An interactive civic-information project focused on explaining electoral processes and helping users explore election-related information.

EarthShare.summary: A carbon-footprint prototype for recording everyday activities, viewing deterministic emissions estimates, and tracking climate actions. The README describes a FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend, and notes that the project is not a security-audited production service.

CalmReader.summary: A reading-focused web app with text and article import, a focus mode that dims surrounding paragraphs, guided questions, and a reflection archive.

Employee-Analysis.summary: The public repository does not currently include a README overview, so its purpose and results cannot be summarized accurately from the available documentation.
